units.rawText: Yuwang, w-what's with this pile of data storage devices...

spans.text: Yuwang, w-what's with this pile of data storage devices...

units.rawText: Ah... Professor. Sorry, I'm still organizing the records we got from the Jiutian Sector. Hold up, my wheelchair is stuck...

units.rawText: Heh, let me help you... I didn't expect the Jiutian Sector to have this many records.
units.displayText: Heh, let me help you... I didn't expect the Jiutian Sector to have this many records.

spans.text: Heh, let me help you... I didn't expect the Jiutian Sector to have this many records.

units.rawText: Some of the records are mixed with information about certain agents in the Jiutian Sector, so I'm in the process of reorganizing them.
units.displayText: Some of the records are mixed with information about certain agents in the Jiutian Sector, so I'm in the process of reorganizing them.

spans.text: Some of the records are mixed with information about certain agents in the Jiutian Sector, so I'm in the process of reorganizing them.

units.rawText: At first, I was just selecting the useful ones to bring back to the real world. But recently, as I read through the records and learned about what you've been through, it stirred something deep in my neural cloud.
units.displayText: At first, I was just selecting the useful ones to bring back to the real world. But recently, as I read through the records and learned about what you've been through, it stirred something deep in my neural cloud.

spans.text: At first, I was just selecting the useful ones to bring back to the real world. But recently, as I read through the records and learned about what you've been through, it stirred something deep in my neural cloud.

units.rawText: I decided to organize all entries we have and return them to each agent who was in the Jiutian Sector.. whilst also preparing for what we must accomplish in the real world for the future.

units.rawText: Sadly, I haven't been in touch with you long enough, Professor, so I don't have much to share. I'm sorry I couldn't be more helpful with your memory recovery...

units.rawText: You've already given me more than I could ever ask for. Thank you.
